options.name: delete_continue
options.description:
Continuous mode: Don't stop on errors.
Only available with 'state: absent'.

options.name: force
options.description:
Force server removal even if it does not exist.
Will always result in changed.
Only available with 'state: absent'.

options.name: hidden
options.description:
Set hidden state of a server.
Only available with 'state: present'.

options.name: ignore_last_of_role
options.description:
Skip a check whether the last CA master or DNS server is removed.
Only available with 'state: absent'.

options.name: ignore_topology_disconnect
options.description:
Ignore topology connectivity problems after removal.
Only available with 'state: absent'.

options.name: ipaapi_context
options.description:
The context in which the module will execute. Executing in a
server context is preferred. If not provided context will be
determined by the execution environment.

options.name: ipaapi_ldap_cache
options.description: Use LDAP cache for IPA connection.

options.name: location
options.description:
The server DNS location.
Only available with 'state: present'.
Use "" for location reset.

options.name: name
options.description: The list of server name strings.

options.name: no_members
options.description:
Suppress processing of membership attributes
Only available with 'state: present'.

options.name: service_weight
options.description:
Weight for server services
Values 0 to 65535, -1 for weight reset.
Only available with 'state: present'.
